items.q: A thick waxy cuticle and sunken stomata are adaptations to:

items.explain: These features reduce water loss in xerophytes.

items.q: Plants in very wet soil that have air spaces in their stems are adapted to:
items.qAf: Plante in baie nat grond wat lugruimtes in hul stingels het, is aangepas by:
items.explain: Aerenchyma lets oxygen reach submerged roots.
items.explainAf: Aerenchiem laat suurstof na ondergedompelde wortels toe.

items.q: Which adaptation helps a plant conserve water in a desert?
items.qAf: Watter aanpassing help ’n plant om water in ’n woestyn te bewaar?
options: Many open stomata during the day
optionsAf: Baie oop huidmondjies gedurende die dag
items.explain: CAM plants open their stomata at night, reducing water loss.
items.explainAf: CAM-plante maak hul huidmondjies snags oop, wat waterverlies verminder.

items.q: Mosses and ferns are non-flowering plants that reproduce using:

items.explainAf: Hulle plant voort deur spore eerder as sade.

items.q: A plant has seeds enclosed in a fruit. It is most likely a:
